blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — Mandaue City traffic enforcers will be allowed to take shelter during periods of extreme heat while remaining within their assigned areas to respond to traffic incidents and other emergencies. Hyll Retuya, head of the Traffic Enforcement Agency of Mandaue said enforcers are not required to stand under direct sunlight for eight hours straight, as the agency also prioritizes their health and safety amid the El Niño-related heat.
